name: vasantham-crm
description: Vasantham Tiles & Sanitary Wares — Customer CRM Workspace

scripts.dev:browser: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,DESKTOP" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix desktop run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:tauri: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,TAURI" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgCyan.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix desktop run dev:tauri"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,DESKTOP,MOBILE" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix desktop run dev:frontend" "npm --prefix mobile start"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix mobile install
